setup: Start in a high plank with legs hip-width and hands supported, fingers pointing away from feet.
Press hands into the floor and contract thigh and glute muscles while retaining a stable trunk.
executionSteps: Lower the body slowly toward the floor while keeping trunk and hips stable.
Press the hands into the floor to return to the high-plank position.
technique.finishOrReset: Return to the described starting support under control before relaxing.
keyCheckpoints: Retain trunk alignment rather than moving the hips separately.

mistakes.mistake: Sagging the low back or raising the hips separately.
mistakes.correction: Reset the supported starting position; use a learned easier variation if control is lost.

setup: Kneel with feet together; place palms shoulder-width and fingers forward.
Shift until shoulders are over hands; keep a straight supported line from knees through torso, with abdominal bracing.
executionSteps: Lower slowly as one supported unit without back sag or raised hips; keep head aligned.
Press back to extended elbows, retaining the same supported alignment.
